summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that Tom Allen sparred three light rounds with Morris O'Connell to close O'Connell's farewell benefit at Kelly's, calling it the tamest set-to ever seen in the room.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Thursday Morning, February 22, 1883', page 5.

facts.fact: Allen sparred three rounds with middleweight Morris O'Connell as the wind-up of O'Connell's farewell benefit at Kelly's in St. Louis; the paper called it the tamest set-to ever seen there

notes: The headline group in 688 ('Ex-Champion Tom Allen Has a Set-To with Morris O'Connell') belongs to this item.
